model_compatibility.config_policy: exact original-manifest equality for resolved AutoConfig and loaded model config; full attention only
model_compatibility.environment_policy: block unvalidated installed-distribution Torch/Transformers versions; record all other original dependency differences and current CUDA/GPU metadata

direction_seed_policy: direction_seed + outer_fold; one fixed draw, no seed selection
score_support: all causal query positions x four GQA heads x original target action tokens, including skipped zero entries
score_certificate_basis: explicit fixed-query QK products from BF16-rotated queries and keys; the downstream SDPA kernel is not directly instrumented
anchor: last prompt token, before single-token A/B/C/D candidate evaluation

zero_checks.direct_bias: every test case, same complete input; tau=0 candidate logits and probabilities exactly equal baseline
zero_checks.key_interventions: all ten direction/calibration conditions on the first case sorted by case_id in each fold
zero_checks.on_difference: persist failed zero audit and stop; never report shape-induced differences as method gains

gqa_policy: per-token same strict cosine sign across all four group query heads; skip disagreement; after BF16 quarantine every token with any actual wrong-sign anchor change and recalibrate
strength_selection: none in this run; reuse prior signed experiment common development selections
head_selection: none in this run; freeze prior B4 development selections
training_data: only the old six training families in each archived fold
new_data_use: sealed confirmation T/F pairs only; no model-based filtering or selection

primary_population.sealed_mechanism: canonical confirmation variants only, 48 cases / 24 base pairs / 8 families

sealed_secondary_population: all 144 cases / 72 surface-variant pairs; also require all six responses per base pair to be correct
bootstrap_unit: clinical or mechanism family, preserving all case/method pairs
primary_interval: 97.5% marginal percentile intervals for two co-primary comparisons; Bonferroni allocation of familywise alpha=.05
secondary_interval: 95% family percentile bootstrap, exploratory and unadjusted
no_claims: no numeric result until real inference has completed
